messages:
lina: dropped a compact spec + figma for run-history previews when tool outputs include structured schema. short goals: avoid PII leaks, keep rows scannable, and make schema affordances discoverable. figma: https://figma.redwood/app/file/abc
ajay: reading — one practical question: how do we decide what to show in the 1-line preview? top-level strings only? first non-empty field?
lina: proposal: show first primitive field (string/number/boolean) under a whitelist of safe keys (message, status, summary). fall back to "(structured result)" if none.
michelle: whitelist is good but will need org override. some clients put emails in `user.email` which we'd want to redact. add sanitization step.
lina: agreed. sketch of sanitization: ```const preview = pickFirstPrimitive(result, whitelist); return scrubPII(preview);```
tony: accessibility note: previews must be reachable via keyboard and tooltip must be screen-reader friendly. I suggest the preview be a button with aria-haspopup="true" and aria-label="Open full tool result"
a11y-bot: Auto-audit: recommended focus-visible style missing for inline preview buttons. Also flagged low contrast for tertiary meta text (#9ca3af on white) at 12px. Suggest #374151 or increase weight.
eng-qa: we'll run keyboard+screenreader smoke after the PR lands. can you add automated tests for focus order?
ajay: copy suggestions for collapsed line: "Preview: message — order accepted" vs shorter "message: order accepted". prefer the shorter but need consistent punctuation.
michelle: users scan fast. short wins. use "message: ..." and only show label when field name ambiguous.
lina: noted. I'll compile strings: ["message: {value}", "(structured result)", "schema • {n} fields", "Open schema", "Output schema"] and post for translation.
tony: UX layout q: badge alignment — if we put schema pill on the right it clashes with a long preview. suggest preview is max 60 chars and pill floats right with ellipsis on preview.
ajay: telemetry: log preview shown/hide events and if redaction occurred so support can trace. add a per-workspace toggle: "show previews in history" default on.
a11y-bot: reminder: any per-org privacy toggle must be exposed in settings and included in consent docs.
eng-qa: scheduling smoke for tomorrow morning, tag @eng-qa if anything blocks.
lina: thanks all — I'll update figma, add the copy doc, and open a small PR with colors, role attrs, and the sanitization stub by EOD. ping me for review :thumbsup:
